The call to HttpClient.GetAsync is non-virtual and the HttpClient instance is created inside the method via HttpClientFactory.Create(). To test this method and control the HttpClient behavior, we need to refactor the WebServices class to allow injecting a HttpClient or a factory delegate for HttpClient creation.

I will apply the parameterize_dependency refactor to allow injecting a HttpClient or a factory delegate for HttpClient creation, so we can pass a mocked HttpClient in the test.

<tool>apply_refactor(transform=parameterize_dependency)</tool>

The parameterize_dependency refactor is not available due to a missing Roslyn tool. I will try the make_virtual refactor on the CheckModVersion method to allow overriding it in a test subclass and intercepting the HttpClient creation and call.

<tool>apply_refactor(transform=make_virtual, method=CheckModVersion)</tool>

<tool>submit_test(csharp)</tool>
```csharp
using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
	public class WebServicesTests
	{
		// A simple HttpMessageHandler to mock HttpClient responses
		private class FakeHttpMessageHandler : HttpMessageHandler
		{
			private readonly HttpResponseMessage _response;

			public FakeHttpMessageHandler(HttpResponseMessage response)
			{
				_response = response;
			}

			protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				return Task.FromResult(_response);
			}
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsModVersionStatus_Latest_WhenResponseIsEmpty()
		{
			// Arrange
			var response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
			{
				Content = new StringContent("")
			};
			var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(response);
			var client = new HttpClient(handler);

			var webServices = new WebServices();

			// We cannot inject the client, so we test the method as-is.
			// The method runs asynchronously and sets ModVersionStatus after awaiting.
			// We will wait a short time and check the ModVersionStatus.

			// Act
			webServices.CheckModVersion();

			// Wait for the async task to complete (up to 2 seconds)
			await Task.Delay(2000);

			// Assert
			Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.Latest, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsModVersionStatus_Outdated_WhenResponseIsOutdated()
		{
			var response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
			{
				Content = new StringContent("outdated")
			};
			var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(response);
			var client = new HttpClient(handler);

			var webServices = new WebServices();

			webServices.CheckModVersion();

			await Task.Delay(2000);

			Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.Outdated, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsModVersionStatus_Unknown_WhenResponseIsUnknown()
		{
			var response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
			{
				Content = new StringContent("unknown")
			};
			var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(response);
			var client = new HttpClient(handler);

			var webServices = new WebServices();

			webServices.CheckModVersion();

			await Task.Delay(2000);

			Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.Unknown, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsModVersionStatus_PlaytestAvailable_WhenResponseIsPlaytest()
		{
			var response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
			{
				Content = new StringContent("playtest")
			};
			var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(response);
			var client = new HttpClient(handler);

			var webServices = new WebServices();

			webServices.CheckModVersion();

			await Task.Delay(2000);

			Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.PlaytestAvailable, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
		}
	}
}
```

The tests failed because the WebServices.CheckModVersion method uses static dependencies (HttpClientFactory.Create and Game.RunAfterTick) that we cannot control or mock, so the ModVersionStatus remains NotChecked.

I will read the Game class to understand how RunAfterTick works and if we can force the delegate to run synchronously in tests.
